outcome: Prenatal care utilization (initiation timing, number of visits)
Antenatal screening (gestational diabetes, dating and anatomy ultrasounds)
cohort: Pregnant persons initiating prenatal care at Grady Memorial Hospital, divided into pre-pandemic (March 1, 2019-August 31, 2019) and pandemic-exposed (March 1, 2020-August 31, 2020) cohorts.
finding: Rates of prenatal care utilization were similar before and during the COVID-19 pandemic, but pandemic-exposed pregnant persons initiated care earlier and had higher utilization of certain antenatal screening services.
mod_finding: Rates of labor induction increased among the pandemic-exposed cohort compared to the pre-pandemic cohort.
